title: Omega swarm wave manifest
description: Coordinator-written pre-assignment of samples (or, for work outside any sample, board items) to sessions. No program in this tree reads or validates this file.

exclusions.description: Items or sessions excluded from this wave for current conflicts or blockers, not standing reservations for future waves.

sample.description: A runnable samples/ project whose main.omg header states `Expected exit` or `Expected output contains`. The session's acceptance is that sample running with its oracle on main; its path is the claimed item. The default kind of session.

board.description: Only for work outside any sample (release, bootstrap or optimizer acceptance).

item.description: Board item name; must appear as **<item>.** in the board file.
